summary: Iteration 33 - Regression tests for the CV analysis bug fixes (formations + centres d'intérêt extraction from CV, ATS keyword propagation in check-offer-match + generate-models). Backend: 5/5 automated tests passed (1 long LLM test skipped). Frontend: 4/5 flows validated. 1 CRITICAL UI BUG found: the 'Formations & Certifications' card renders with empty content because frontend expects fields diplome/etablissement/annee but backend passport stores title/institution/year.

ui_bugs.issue: The card lists the 4 CV formations count (badge shows '4') but each entry only displays the type badge (Diplôme/Diplôme/Certification/Mooc). Titles (Titre professionnel CIP, Licence de Psychologie, Certification VAE, MOOC Numérique et inclusion), establishment (AFPA Strasbourg...) and year (2014...) are ALL EMPTY. Root cause: field name mismatch — frontend uses f.diplome/f.etablissement/f.annee while backend passport.formations stores title/institution/year (see /api/passport response: {id, title, institution, year, type, level, description, source, visibility}).

action_items: Fix field mapping in /app/frontend/src/views/ParticulierView.jsx lines 1722-1740: change f.diplome -> f.title, f.etablissement -> f.institution, f.annee -> f.year (or normalise backend to also expose diplome/etablissement/annee aliases in /api/passport). Same care needed for CvAnalysisSection / any other formation rendering.
Also review the Ma trajectoire timeline (frise) which currently shows only 'Suggestion IA' formations, not the CV-sourced ones — CV formations should be represented on the passport timeline too.
critical_code_review_comments: Field name inconsistency: backend model Passport stores formations with keys title/institution/year (server.py ~L3234-L3245 fallback and L3047-L3058 main extraction) while frontend renderer expects diplome/etablissement/annee. This causes silent rendering (component visible but empty).
Consider a single source of truth Pydantic schema shared between frontend/backend to prevent such drift.

rca_of_the_issue: Frontend renders passport.formations using f.diplome/f.etablissement/f.annee (ParticulierView.jsx L1728-1731) but the backend passport.formations documents (server.py L3234-3245 & L3047-3058) use title/institution/year. As a result, each formation card is displayed (count is right, type badge is right because type field matches) but the main content is blank. Fix: rename frontend accessors to f.title/f.institution/f.year, or add a schema mapping layer in the API/GET /api/passport response.
